# Anti-Slop agent claim verification

> Make AI coding agents cite receipts, not vibes.
>
> Deterministic agent claim verification for AI coding agents. Generic entrypoint:
> `anti-slop-claims`. Surface #1 / compatibility preset: `anti-slop-pr` for
> AI-written PR descriptions. Both check whether file / test / source-card /
> issue / commit references actually RESOLVE against the repo. `anti-slop-claims`
> can write structured JSON receipts and can hard-check changed-file wording
> against a supplied local git diff/range. `anti-slop-run` writes local command
> receipts; `anti-slop-claims --receipts` checks command-pass/exit and simple
> metric claims against fresh receipts. They do NOT verify correctness,
> relevance, support, benchmark validity, safety, source truth, advice quality,
> reasoning, or canon. Stdlib only; no model, network, GitHub API, or token.

## Install it (for agents)

- [INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md): the full install-and-wire-CI protocol.
- One-line user prompt: "Install anti-slop-pr in this repo, run the smoke, add report-mode CI, and open a PR."

Exact commands:
- Install: `pip install "anti-slop-lineage @ git+https://github.com/nferna26/anti-slop"`
- Self-test: `anti-slop-claims --self-test`, `anti-slop-run --self-test`, `anti-slop-pr --self-test`, and `anti-slop-pr-event --self-test`
- Check a generic artifact: `anti-slop-claims --root . AGENT_FINAL_REPORT.md`  (add `--report` for advisory)
- Write JSON: `anti-slop-claims --root . --json claims.json AGENT_FINAL_REPORT.md`
- Diff-aware changed-file check: `anti-slop-claims --root . --diff HEAD~1..HEAD AGENT_FINAL_REPORT.md`
- Write a command receipt: `anti-slop-run -- make validate`
- Check command/metric claims: `anti-slop-claims --root . --receipts .anti-slop/receipts AGENT_FINAL_REPORT.md`
- Check a PR body: `anti-slop-pr --root . <pr-body.md>`  (add `--report` for advisory)
- GitHub Actions: copy `templates/anti-slop-pr.yml` → `.github/workflows/` (report mode; drop `--report` to enforce)
- Demo/proof from this repo: `make agent-claim-demo`, `make agent-claim-benchmark`, `make agent-claim-audit`

- [docs/agent-claim-verification.md](docs/agent-claim-verification.md): supported-claims matrix and out-of-scope boundary.

- [README.md](README.md): the Anti-Slop front door and evidence history.

## Tiers (deterministic vs advisory)

- Deterministic (hard fail): file refs (path-like), test nodes, source-card/source refs, changed-file refs under `--diff`, command/metric claims when detected.
- Advisory (never fails): issue refs without a registry; commit-SHA refs.
- Default adoption is report mode; blocking enforcement is explicit opt-in.
